public-goods-grid.alt: A two-by-two grid. Columns: rival and nonrival. Rows: excludable and nonexcludable. Rival and excludable: private goods, such as a sandwich or a bike. Nonrival and excludable: club goods, such as a streaming service. Rival and nonexcludable: common resources, such as fish in the ocean. Nonrival and nonexcludable: public goods, such as national defense or a flood wall.
